scope: CP45 normal image guidance without model inference or external AI; existing photo permissions and real circle transactions

environment.fixtures: Generated isolated local databases and images; four existing public project assets for exact-hash cases; no user database

test_run.skip_reason: Retained historical test_real_model_uses_pixels is explicitly inactive because CP45 forbids actual inference in the normal presentation/runtime. It is not reported as passed.

verified: Startup with an absent model directory and no API keys; model constructor and inference/AI package imports are guarded against use
No network connection is needed for startup or the tested condition/candidate/invitation/confirmation flow
Old worker=True configuration cannot start image inference with ImageGuidance
Known public asset bytes alone produce predefined tag hints without confidence scores; arbitrary photos and misleading filenames remain manual with no hints
Uploads and compatibility analyze calls return terminal manual/guided status without queuing inference
A user can explicitly select and publish photo tags; another member receives selected post tags but no private candidate details
Historical queued/running/succeeded/failed job values, tags, scores and model versions remain unchanged in the database while API responses terminate waiting
Local condition templates, actual candidate saving, pending provider invitation, provider acceptance and two-party proposal confirmation continue to persist; reservation remains not_booked
A temporarily locked logically deleted photo is denied by the API immediately, then physically removed by inference-free startup cleanup; active media remains
review_correction: Separated bounded logical-deletion cleanup from inference so disabling image workers does not remove the existing file-removal retry path.
processing_boundary: MOC comments explicitly identify fixed outputs and a future external-AI adapter boundary. No API client, SDK, keys or external network opening were implemented; authorization, consent, structured validation and saving remain server responsibilities.
limitations: Docker deployment and production-volume preservation are parent-agent validations recorded separately.
Network-disabled checks use in-process ASGI and connection/import guards, not an operating-system egress certification.
No model accuracy or actual inference result is claimed; model code/assets remain stored but inactive in normal operation.
The deletion retry cursor is new maintenance state; it only targets previously authorized deleted=1 media and is bounded to 32 rows per pass.
